original_vs_archived_scope.problem: Late residual reconstruction creates sharing after copy expansion when block joins and channel spilling are disabled.
original_vs_archived_scope.fix: Run required residual reconstruction before sharing expansion.
original_vs_archived_scope.remaining_claim: Keep acceptance tied to the original stage-lifecycle controls and exact executable evidence; do not require broad unsupported-type feature work to prove this lifecycle correction.

original_vs_archived_scope.problem: Nullable unique keys and relations without known keys were rejected before reconstruction, independently of the late-sharing stage ordering.
original_vs_archived_scope.current_fix: Admit exact scalar keyless row domains, supported nullable identity encoding and zero-column logical identity; guard unstable copies and unsupported domains.
original_vs_archived_scope.remaining_claim: Broad floating/composite/opaque keyless identities and per-occurrence volatile keyless predicates remain unimplemented support goals. They are explicit guarded exclusions, not silently claimed solved and not evidence that the original late-sharing bug persists.

original_vs_archived_scope.problem: Both reconstruction identities must denote the same evaluated producer value when aggregate output can vary between independent evaluations.
original_vs_archived_scope.remaining_claim: The two spilling-domain profiles already have semantic/physical presence evidence, but require exact field-to-shared-port lineage. This is a real verification obligation of the added scalar-domain fix.

original_vs_archived_scope.problem: A retained block residual supposedly becomes Lookup and introduces late sharing.
original_vs_archived_scope.disposition: Source proof rejects this ordinary pipeline path; do not revive it without new reachable evidence.
Separate C47 follow-up. Existing import-time TableLookup sharing is not late C31 reconstruction sharing.

guard_matrix.behavior: Every output field must satisfy HasExactScalarIdentity; keyless predicates and referenced subplans must be repeatable, and referenced subplan reductions must be stable.
HasExactScalarIdentity is required, then supported optional values use StablePickle. Optional Float/Double, nested optional, bare Null and opaque/container types fail the whitelist.
The existing key type is not subject to the new scalar whitelist. Its validity is not newly certified by that whitelist. Keyed residuals are not subject to the keyless predicate-repeatability gate.

guard_matrix.input: any producer when channel spilling is disabled
guard_matrix.behavior: HasStableJoinFilterReductions recursively checks aggregate grouping keys, reductions and referenced producer subplans before copying. Float/Double grouping keys are rejected even for COUNT-only aggregates.

guard_matrix.input: producer when channel spilling is enabled
guard_matrix.behavior: The no-spill copy-stability gate is skipped; same evaluated producer/value lineage is required. Separate keyless field/subplan restrictions still apply.

float_identity_source_disposition.metadata_evidence: TOpAggregate::ComputeMetadata at kqp_rbo_compute_statistics.cpp:480-507 can declare grouping or deduplication keys unique without a type whitelist; table primary-key type limits do not rule out derived Float/Double uniqueness.
float_identity_source_disposition.no_spill_scope: HasStableJoinFilterReductions at inline_join_filters.cpp:51-66 rejects Float/Double grouping representatives before independent copies, including COUNT-only grouping.
float_identity_source_disposition.spilling_scope: Known nonoptional Float/Double identities can bypass the scalar-domain whitelist; source equality must be assessed on the same evaluated producer value.
float_identity_source_disposition.map_join: mkql_map_join.cpp uses dictionary Contains/Lookup. Dictionary comparison through CompareKeys/CompareFloats and specialized TFloatEquals treats NaN as equal to NaN; GetFloatHash supplies a consistent NaN hash.
float_identity_source_disposition.grace_join: mkql_grace_join.cpp:221 clears packed integer storage, then :293-297 writes Float/Double values into it. mkql_grace_join_imp.cpp:594 onward compares packed key words. Identical already-evaluated bits compare equal. Different NaN payloads or signed-zero representatives are not newly certified equivalent by this statement.
float_identity_source_disposition.block_join: dq_block_hash_join.cpp:97 packs through the block layout converter. block_layout_converter.cpp:130,735 marks floating fields; tuple.cpp:32-43 canonicalizes zero and NaN before packed-key comparison; scalar and SIMD pack paths invoke canonicalization. Packed keys are compared through TTupleLayout::KeysEqual.
float_identity_source_disposition.candidate_disposition: No NaN self-equality production bug established. IEEE scalar equality alone would have produced an incorrect bug report. Existing physical shared-value proof remains necessary, particularly for packed-bit representatives.
float_identity_source_disposition.limits: Source-only conclusion. No native Float/Double identity workload was created or executed, and no general equivalence guarantee for opaque/composite identities is claimed.

verifier_issue.problem: The probe uses a single-body lambda parser throughout general program traversal; valid ExpandMap wide projections have multiple lambda bodies.
verifier_issue.source_contract: BuildExpandMapForNarrowInput in kqp_rbo_physical_convertion_utils.h:60 emits multiple Member bodies; yql_expr.cpp:2005 serializes them as multiple lambda children. Local bindings can instead produce a block body at :1979.
verifier_issue.change: General traversal accepts all lambda bodies; stage programs and direct projection checks remain single-body. It does not add block-scope resolution or field lineage and never changes any full-proof flag.

dormant_observation_module.purpose: Delegate only the existing two domain-spilling profiles, retain the original physical verdict, bind frozen dependency hashes, and record an allowlisted shape inventory plus conservative topology observation.
dormant_observation_module.privacy: No new workload strings or rendered expressions are stored. Observation outputs only hashes, approved callable names, counters, fixed join-kind labels and Boolean checks.

minimal_actual_next_probe.driver: native_verify.py with --cases and --generator-module c31_scope_observation; execute through the existing parent-owned serial memory guard and exact C31 executable receipt after independent artifact review.
minimal_actual_next_probe.workload_policy: Use the existing generators and anonymous AST/SQL/result memfds. Keep all generated material in memory and persist only sanitized evidence.
minimal_actual_next_probe.evidence_merge: Append observation evidence. Preserve the existing 50-record semantic/guard batch and its distinct scope; do not overwrite it with only the two observations.
minimal_actual_next_probe.expected_limit: Topology false is a conservative shape rejection, not proof of a production bug. All three full shared-value proof flags remain false.

proposed_field_proof_after_observation: Resolve actual lexical scopes, stage arguments, TDqOutput ports and wide-column positions. Do not rely on stage-wide aggregation token presence.

Trace every compared reconstruction key through value-preserving transports, direct maps and join output renames to distinct ports of one terminal Switch. Follow both key encoders, if present, and require matching codec and source field.
Recognize the inner domain as pure key-only deduplication, prove complete key-field coverage, and reject any unproved reducer or value computation downstream of the shared hub.

Require both compared fields to reach the same already-evaluated source field of that hub. This sufficient strategy can treat the upstream producer calculation as opaque for identity, avoiding an unnecessary general symbolic SUM evaluator.

Separately bind the intended aggregate result to an identity field for profile coverage. If the actual hub is upstream of that reduction, or a post-hub recomputation occurs, retain failure and trace the required aggregate/UNION field mapping instead.
Obtain independent review of the complete field proof and bind its result to the same actual AST/revision/generator hashes before changing any full-proof flag.
